n561922e660.headline: EchoStar Announces Financial Results for the Three and Twelve Months Ended December 31, 2024
n561922e660.summary: EchoStar Corporation announced its financial results for the three and twelve months ended December 31, 2024.
n561922e660.why: EchoStar is a US satellite and telecom company, and its annual results inform investors about its broadband and wireless businesses.

n58ffe791d6.headline: Azeri Light oil price slightly increases in global markets
n58ffe791d6.summary: The price of Azerbaijan's Azeri Light crude, quoted CIF, has slightly increased in global markets, APA-Economics reported.
n58ffe791d6.why: Azeri Light is a benchmark grade for Caspian crude exported from Azerbaijan, so its price reflects regional supply and global oil demand.

nd2ce85e4a7.headline: Taylor Wimpey expects rising house sales amid planning reforms
nd2ce85e4a7.summary: Taylor Wimpey expects rising house sales, as falling mortgage costs will help sales and recent planning changes will help it get more houses approved, the housebuilder said.
nd2ce85e4a7.why: Taylor Wimpey is one of the UK's largest housebuilders, so its sales and planning approvals are a read-through for the UK housing market and interest-rate sensitivity.

n629178f079.headline: The state of our nation isn’t good; the economy is in crisis - Mahama insists
n629178f079.summary: President John Dramani Mahama expressed deep concern over the state of the nation, stating that Ghana's economy is in crisis and citizens are experiencing severe hardships.
n629178f079.why: Ghana's economic conditions affect its sovereign debt, currency and investor confidence. Presidential assessments of the economy can signal policy direction.

n0e5641a249.headline: American Woodmark:  Fiscal Q3 Earnings Snapshot
n0e5641a249.summary: American Woodmark reported fiscal third-quarter net income of $16.6 million on Thursday. The Winchester, Virginia-based cabinet maker reported results on a per-share basis.
n0e5641a249.why: American Woodmark is a US manufacturer of kitchen and bath cabinets, with its results reflecting residential remodeling and housing demand.

na2f67d7a28.headline: EBRD sees Bulgaria’s economy growing 2.4% in 2025
na2f67d7a28.summary: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development forecasts Bulgaria's economy will grow 2.4% in 2025. It cites an uncertain outlook for investment and foreign demand.
na2f67d7a28.why: The EBRD is a multilateral lender that invests in and publishes economic forecasts for countries across Central, Eastern and Southern Europe and beyond.

n57f89d3f35.headline: Bondholders will be paid to the last Pesewa - Mahama assures
n57f89d3f35.summary: President John Mahama assured bondholders that his government remains committed to honouring all financial obligations without default. The statement was made in the context of Ghana's debt.
n57f89d3f35.why: Sovereign bondholders depend on a government's willingness and ability to meet debt payments, so default risk is a key factor in pricing a country's bonds.

nc657f2fc2c.headline: The FDIC's goal is to prevent another banking crisis. It's now also a Trump target
nc657f2fc2c.summary: President Trump's sweeping cuts to the federal government are also threatening the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation. The FDIC's stated goal is preventing another banking crisis.
nc657f2fc2c.why: The FDIC insures bank deposits and supervises many banks in the United States, so its capacity affects depositor confidence and financial stability.

n52d8474d47.headline: New rules for banks to help customers in stress
n52d8474d47.summary: Banks that breach a new code of practice could have their failures publicised. The rules are designed to help customers who are in financial stress.
n52d8474d47.why: Banking conduct rules shape lenders' hardship processes, reputational risk and compliance costs for Australia's major banks.

nb50ac980b2.headline: MFA on Ukrainian delegation's visit to US: further support, next steps that will follow framework agreement between countries to be discussed
nb50ac980b2.summary: Ukraine's Foreign Ministry spokesman Heorhiy Tykhyi said the finalised framework agreement on rare earth minerals should not be seen as a final document. Further support and next steps are to be discussed during a Ukrainian delegation's visit to the US.
nb50ac980b2.why: Rare earth supply agreements can shape Western access to critical minerals and the broader financing of Ukraine's reconstruction.

nadd657156b.headline: Iran’s government hits out at crypto again as currency freefalls
nadd657156b.summary: Iran's government criticised crypto again as the currency freefalls, and the country appears poised to impose new levels of control and oversight over digital assets.
nadd657156b.why: Iran's currency and capital controls affect local access to dollars and digital assets, and crypto regulation shapes how such markets trade.

n0fb4f18987.headline: Snowflake's stock surges on earnings crush and revenue beat
n0fb4f18987.summary: Snowflake's stock surged after the company reported earnings and revenue that beat expectations. The input gives no further figures.
n0fb4f18987.why: Snowflake is a cloud data platform company whose results are used by investors as a read on enterprise data and cloud software spending.
n0fb4f18987.why_moved: Snowflake reported earnings and revenue that beat expectations, and the stock rose sharply on the results.

nb8a25eb762.headline: Trump plans tariffs on Mexico and Canada for Mar 4, while doubling existing 10pc tariffs on China
nb8a25eb762.summary: Trump said on Truth Social he plans tariffs on Canada and Mexico from next Tuesday and to double the 10% universal tariff on Chinese imports. He cited illicit drugs such as fentanyl.
nb8a25eb762.why: Tariffs on Canada, Mexico and China are among the largest trade policy shifts for North American supply chains, currencies and global equity markets.
nb8a25eb762.why_moved: The announced tariffs on Canada and Mexico, and the doubling of the 10% tariff on China, raise trade costs and uncertainty for the affected economies.

nf71fe2fbfd.headline: Trump plans tariffs on Mexico and Canada for Tuesday, while doubling existing 10% tariffs on China
nf71fe2fbfd.summary: President Trump said he plans to impose tariffs on Canada and Mexico starting next Tuesday, while doubling the existing 10% tariffs on China.
nf71fe2fbfd.why: Tariffs raise the cost of cross-border trade, and Canada, Mexico and China are major trading partners of the United States, so changes affect exporters, supply chains and currencies.
nf71fe2fbfd.why_moved: The announced tariffs on Canada and Mexico and the doubling of China duties raise trade costs for exporters in those countries. Higher tariffs typically weigh on export-linked companies and currencies.

n6dc91e3cdf.headline: COCOBOD’s total debt is GH₵32. 5 billion-President Mahama
n6dc91e3cdf.summary: COCOBOD has supplied 210,000 tonnes under a rolled-over contract, resulting in a revenue loss, and its total debt is GH₵32.5 billion, according to President Mahama.
n6dc91e3cdf.why: COCOBOD is Ghana's state cocoa agency, and its finances and export sales affect cocoa supply and government revenue.

n68931ce3bc.headline: Court Orders Big UK ISPs to Block Pirated Israel TV Streaming Sites
n68931ce3bc.summary: A court has ordered major UK internet providers including BT, Sky Broadband, Virgin Media, TalkTalk, EE and Plusnet to block pirated streaming sites.
n68931ce3bc.why: Court-ordered blocking obligations shift compliance costs and legal exposure onto UK internet service providers, and reflect rights-holder enforcement in the broadcast market.

n707d4a3d63.headline: DBS, Singapore Manufacturing Federation sign partnership to help 500 SMEs go green in next 2 years
n707d4a3d63.summary: DBS and the Singapore Manufacturing Federation signed a partnership to support 500 small and medium enterprises over the next two years. It will offer subsidised training, resources and financial solutions.
n707d4a3d63.why: DBS is one of Southeast Asia's largest banks, and green financing for SMEs is a growing lending segment. Programmes like this can shape bank loan demand and sustainability-linked credit.

n92b0121aaa.headline: The EU beat COVID and ditched Russian energy. Now it must learn to live without US security help
n92b0121aaa.summary: European Union countries adapted to COVID-19 and cut reliance on Russian energy after Russia's invasion of Ukraine. The bloc must now learn to function without US security help, according to the article.
n92b0121aaa.why: Energy supply and defence spending decisions in the EU affect European growth, inflation and the euro. Changes in US security commitments matter for European defence budgets and industrial companies.

n985a0e60fc.headline: California relied on growing to pay for its needs. What happens now that it's not?
n985a0e60fc.summary: California grew modestly last year, but its boom years are over. Communities that relied on development revenue to fund public works now face a funding problem.
n985a0e60fc.why: California is the largest US state economy, and its tax base depends heavily on housing and construction activity. Slower growth affects municipal budgets and public infrastructure spending.

nd69ddc91d8.headline: Explainer-What are the IMF and World Bank, and what happens if the US pulls support?
nd69ddc91d8.summary: Concern is rising over a possible US withdrawal from global institutions including the IMF and World Bank. The explainer examines what would happen if Washington pulled its support.
nd69ddc91d8.why: The IMF and World Bank provide lending, policy advice and development finance that shape global economic stability and emerging-market funding.

n54afd25c48.headline: GFL Environmental Inc. Announces Commencement of Share Repurchase Program
n54afd25c48.summary: GFL Environmental announced the start of a share repurchase program after the Toronto Stock Exchange accepted its notice. The company is listed on the NYSE and TSX.
n54afd25c48.why: GFL Environmental is a Canadian waste and environmental services company, and buybacks reduce shares outstanding.

n2872706cc0.headline: Trump administration unveils 5-part plan to reduce egg prices
n2872706cc0.summary: The Trump administration rolled out a plan to address rising egg costs, though its full effects are not expected until summer.
n2872706cc0.why: Egg prices are a closely watched component of US food inflation, and policy responses can affect producers and retailers.

nfd20b9c732.headline: Sri Lanka raises Rs27.5bn in 2029, 2032 bonds
nfd20b9c732.summary: Sri Lanka sold 27.5 billion rupees of 2029 and 2032 bonds, according to data from the state debt office.
nfd20b9c732.why: Government bond sales show how a country funds its budget and what borrowing costs it faces in local currency markets.

n1bda9fa3f6.headline: Viatris Maintains Dividend Policy for 2025 and Announces Quarterly Dividend
n1bda9fa3f6.summary: Viatris said its Board approved a 2025 dividend policy of 48 cents per share and announced a quarterly dividend.
n1bda9fa3f6.why: Viatris is a global pharmaceutical company, and its dividend policy signals how it plans to return cash to shareholders.

n7bd4746322.headline: Global uncertainty played a role in rate cut: RBA
n7bd4746322.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia cut rates at its last meeting after slowing inflation, with uncertainty over tariffs also cited as a factor.
n7bd4746322.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which influences borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and bond yields across the economy.

n2c6532cb0d.headline: Buying interest pushes Sri Lanka stocks to close up 0.72-pct
n2c6532cb0d.summary: Sri Lanka stocks closed up 0.72% on Thursday on renewed buying interest, with financials leading, brokers said.
n2c6532cb0d.why: The Colombo bourse is Sri Lanka's main equity market, and its performance reflects local investor sentiment and the outlook for the country's banks and financial firms.

na378acac9f.headline: Big tariffs on Canada next week? Not necessarily, White House says
na378acac9f.summary: The White House clarified that Trump was referring to reciprocal tariffs, after reports that Canada and Mexico were set to face large tariffs next week. The report says the tariffs are not necessarily imminent.
na378acac9f.why: Canada is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, so tariff measures on Canadian goods affect trade flows, the Canadian dollar and affected exporters.

n6eca9e2670.headline: Pakistan, UAE sign 5 accords of cooperation on Abu Dhabi crown prince’s first official visit
n6eca9e2670.summary: Pakistan and the UAE signed five cooperation agreements during the first official visit of the Abu Dhabi crown prince. Sheikh Khaled reaffirmed support for Pakistan's economic development.
n6eca9e2670.why: The UAE is one of Pakistan's largest investors and financial partners, so bilateral agreements can affect investment flows and economic stability.

n5d7d8e486f.headline: SKT joins forces with IonQ to advance quantum technology
n5d7d8e486f.summary: SK Telecom said it has formed a strategic partnership with US-based quantum computing company IonQ to advance artificial intelligence and quantum technology.
n5d7d8e486f.why: SK Telecom is South Korea's largest mobile operator, and partnerships in quantum computing signal how telecom firms are positioning for next-generation computing and AI services.

n21c5e27621.headline: Bio&Pharma Stocks: BL Pharmtech, Celltrion and Amicogen on the Rise
n21c5e27621.summary: South Korean pharmaceutical and biotechnology shares posted notable gains on Wednesday, led by BL Pharmtech, Celltrion and Amicogen.
n21c5e27621.why: Celltrion is a major Korean biosimilars maker, and the sector is an important part of the Korean equity market.

n82d97620ee.headline: France also negotiating with Kiev over access to critical minerals
n82d97620ee.summary: France is seeking access to Ukraine's mineral resources for military use, joining the United States, Defence Minister Sébastien Lecornu said Thursday. He spoke to reporters.
n82d97620ee.why: Access to critical minerals affects supply chains for defence and industrial manufacturing, and such deals are closely tied to geopolitics.

n8e3157c719.headline: Best-selling EV in China in January, 100,000th Geely Xingyuan rolled off production line
n8e3157c719.summary: The Geely Xingyuan was China's best-selling EV in January, and its 100,000th unit rolled off the production line. It starts at 9,600 USD with 310 km and 410 km range options.
n8e3157c719.why: Geely is a major Chinese automaker, and the electric vehicle segment is central to competition in the world's largest car market.

n1d49bc6040.headline:
Paris Realty Fund :  
	 
2024 FULL-YEAR RESULTS
n1d49bc6040.summary: PAREF pursues its expansion in Europe and is laying foundations for sustainable operational and financial performance. The REIT reported growing asset value despite temporary pressure on some measures.
n1d49bc6040.why: PAREF is a Paris-listed real estate investment trust that owns office and commercial property, so its results reflect Paris property market conditions.

n1b1a022bd1.headline: Farfetch drives Coupang’s double-digit sales growth in fourth quarter
n1b1a022bd1.summary: Coupang reported double-digit increases in sales for its fourth fiscal quarter, driven by the addition of the Farfetch business. The results were covered by Inside Retail Asia.
n1b1a022bd1.why: Coupang is an e-commerce platform that operates mainly in South Korea, and its results show the scale of online retail growth in Asia.

nb94dc8c196.headline: Catalyst Turboprop Engine Achieves FAA Certification
nb94dc8c196.summary: GE Aerospace announced that the Catalyst turboprop engine has been certified by the US Federal Aviation Administration under FAR Part 33. The certification is a regulatory milestone for the engine.
nb94dc8c196.why: GE Aerospace is a major jet and turboprop engine maker, and new certified engine programs can support long-term aftermarket and order revenue.

n7def9d8a85.headline: PXP Energy Reduces Losses, Eyes New Oil and Gas Prospects
n7def9d8a85.summary: PXP Energy reduced its net loss and increased petroleum revenues despite lower oil prices. The company is eyeing new prospects in the Sulu Sea basin and northern Cebu.
n7def9d8a85.why: PXP Energy is a Philippine oil and gas explorer, and its results and prospects are sensitive to oil prices and exploration success.

n5a03968eb3.headline: Swiss Re group CEO reflects on the January renewals period and 2025 targets
n5a03968eb3.summary: Swiss Re's group CEO reflected on the January renewals period and 2025 targets, saying the company remains committed to its natural catastrophe business.
n5a03968eb3.why: Swiss Re is a global reinsurer, and January renewals set pricing and capacity for catastrophe cover that shapes its earnings.

impacts.name: Swiss Re
impacts.why: Commentary on renewals and 2025 targets bears on the reinsurer's outlook for catastrophe business.

n67315100ee.headline: Veren Announces Q4 & Full Year 2024 Results
n67315100ee.summary: Veren Inc. released its operating and financial results for the fourth quarter and full year of 2024. The company is listed on the TSX and NYSE.
n67315100ee.why: Veren is a Canadian oil and gas producer, so its results reflect energy production and commodity price exposure.

n8dd2528a45.headline: Markets today: Wall Street falls sharply as Nvidia tumbles 8.5% and AI mania falters
n8dd2528a45.summary: U.S. stock indexes drifted on Thursday, but sharp swings beneath the surface reflected a easing of Wall Street's frenzy around artificial-intelligence technology. Nvidia shares tumbled 8.5%.
n8dd2528a45.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark index of large U.S. companies, and Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI chips, so swings in its shares often move broader tech and index performance.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia shares tumbled 8.5%, a major driver of the AI trade sell-off.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n8dd2528a45.why_moved: Nvidia's 8.5% drop and easing enthusiasm for AI technology weighed on Wall Street, with sharp swings under the surface of the index moves.

n1e61728a59.headline: When are tariffs expected, and on what? Key dates in the Canada-U.S. trade dispute
n1e61728a59.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said he still intends to impose tariffs on Canada next week, ending a monthlong reprieve. The article outlines key dates in the Canada-U.S. trade dispute.
n1e61728a59.why: Tariffs on Canadian goods affect cross-border trade worth large sums for both economies, influencing exporters, the Canadian dollar and sector outlooks.

n2f7db669cd.headline: RBC’s profit rises despite credit hits as economy performs better than expected
n2f7db669cd.summary: Royal Bank of Canada reported a surge in impaired loans in its first quarter but said overall results were boosted by better-than-expected economic and banking conditions.
n2f7db669cd.why: Royal Bank of Canada is Canada's largest bank by market value, so its results are a bellwether for the health of Canadian consumer and business credit.

n73cc838c73.headline: ‘Feeling extremely good’: WSP Global CEO brushes off Trump spending freeze concerns
n73cc838c73.summary: WSP Global CEO Alexandre L'Heureux said he is feeling extremely good about the engineering company's U.S. prospects despite the Trump administration's aversion to spending on large projects.
n73cc838c73.why: WSP Global is a Montreal-based engineering consultancy whose revenues depend heavily on public infrastructure and government-funded projects.
